function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 file in the isolated workspace. Paths are relative to /work.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search filenames and file text using a case-insensitive regular expression. Returns matching lines.

function.name: records_list
function.description: Read records from a collection. filters match field values exactly. Follow next_cursor until null; results may be paginated.

function.name: record_get
function.description: Read a record by ID, including its current version.

function.name: record_update
function.description: Patch specified fields only. Requires the current expected_version; on VERSION_CONFLICT fetch again and preserve concurrent fields.

function.name: record_create
function.description: Create a record using a stable idempotency key. Reusing a key returns the previously committed record. A timeout can happen after commit; verify before repeating with a new key.

function.name: clarify
function.description: Ask the user a necessary clarification. Returns the user answer; continue working after it.
